newsitem.title: USA: HILL WINS HIS FIRST TITLE OF YEAR AT BANK ONE CLASSIC.
newsitem.headline: HILL WINS HIS FIRST TITLE OF YEAR AT BANK ONE CLASSIC.

text.p: Mike Hill earned his first Senior Tour victory of the year Sunday in the $600,000 Bank One Senior Classic at Kearney Hill Links.
Hill, who shared the lead with three other golfers entering the final round, carded a four-under-par 68 to finish at nine-under 207, one stroke ahead of Gibby Gilbert and Isao Aoki of Japan.
Hill, the younger brother of fellow Senior Tour performer Dave Hill, picked up $90,000 for his 18th career victory and first since last year's Kroger Senior Classic.
Gilbert, who won the inaugural Boone Valley Classic last week, and 1994 champion Aoki finished at eight-under 208. Gilbert shot a 68, while Aoki fired a final-round 66.

After Hill bogeyed the second hole, he stormed through the front nine with birdies on four of the next seven holes. He added birdies on the 11th and 12th holes before bogeying the 16th and parring out the final two holes.
"It wasn't so easy as it looked," said Hill, who extended his streak of winning at least one title to seven years, the longest active streak on the Senior Tour.
"I had to go out and play golf."
Defending champion Gary Player shot a 72 to finish at even-par 216.
